```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# To render this CV locally:
# install.packages(c("vitae", "rmarkdown", "tinytex"))
# tinytex::install_tinytex() # only needed if you do not already have LaTeX installed
# From the repository root: rmarkdown::render("professional/full-cv.Rmd")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(vitae)

# Allow rendering from either the repository root or the professional/ folder.
cv_paths <- c("content/complete_cv.csv", "../content/complete_cv.csv")
cv_path <- cv_paths[file.exists(cv_paths)][1]
if (is.na(cv_path)) {
  stop("Cannot locate content/complete_cv.csv. Check the repository layout.")
}
cv <- read.csv(cv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required_columns <- c("section", "subsection", "what", "when", "with", "where", "why")
if (!all(required_columns %in% names(cv))) {
  stop("CV CSV is missing required columns: ",
       paste(setdiff(required_columns, names(cv)), collapse = ", "))
}
cv[is.na(cv)] <- ""
cv$section <- trimws(cv$section)  # CSV has a trailing space in 'Professional Organization '


entry_data <- function(section_name, subsection_name = NULL) {
  dat <- cv[cv$section == section_name, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(subsection_name)) {
    dat <- dat[dat$subsection == subsection_name, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  dat
}

print_detailed <- function(section_name, subsection_name = NULL) {
  dat <- entry_data(section_name, subsection_name)
  detailed_entries(dat, what = what, when = when, with = with, where = where, why = why)
}

print_brief <- function(section_name, subsection_name = NULL) {
  dat <- entry_data(section_name, subsection_name)
  brief_entries(dat, what = what, when = when, with = with)
}

latex_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""

  # Local LaTeX escaping avoids depending on xfun::escape_latex(),
  # which is not exported in some installed xfun versions.
  replacements <- c(
    "\\" = "\\textbackslash{}",
    "&"  = "\\&",
    "%"  = "\\%",
    "$"  = "\\$",
    "#"  = "\\#",
    "_"  = "\\_",
    "{"  = "\\{",
    "}"  = "\\}",
    "~"  = "\\textasciitilde{}",
    "^"  = "\\textasciicircum{}"
  )

  vapply(x, function(value) {
    if (!nzchar(value)) return("")
    chars <- strsplit(value, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    paste0(ifelse(chars %in% names(replacements), replacements[chars], chars), collapse = "")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

print_awards_grants <- function() {
  dat <- entry_data("Awards & Grants")
  dat <- dat[dat$what != "", , drop = FALSE]

  cat("\\begin{cvhonors}\n")
  invisible(apply(dat, 1, function(row) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\\cvaward{%s}{%s}{%s}{%s}\n",
      latex_escape(row[["when"]]),   # year
      latex_escape(row[["what"]]),   # award/grant name
      latex_escape(row[["with"]]),   # organization
      latex_escape(row[["where"]])   # award amount or note
    ))
  }))
  cat("\\end{cvhonors}\n")
}
```
